prompt: Before 2024, among her own record-breaking streaks, in which Olympic event has Katie Ledecky broken the world record the second most times?
answer: The **women’s 1,500-meter freestyle**. Before the 2024 Paris Olympics, Ledecky had broken that event’s world record **five times**, second only to her **six** 800-meter freestyle world-record improvements.
